reviewDecisions.rationale: PPE scarcity and meltblown bottlenecks were extreme and independently verified; deep research must determine whether earnings duration outlasts emergency capacity additions.
Official policy acceleration and resilient 5G/server orders provide a direct infrastructure thesis, subject to expectation absorption.
Server/cloud demand and Q2 memory pricing strengthened simultaneously; direct A-share mapping and duration remain open.
The oil shock is economically dominant and useful both as an avoidance signal and as a test against simplistic downstream-beneficiary logic.
Record auto-demand collapse should fail closed unless a differentiated company engine is already visible.
The monetary regime improved after forced liquidation, but the price path remained unstable enough to require deep earnings/expectation checks.
Reopening is real but low-base; use it to search for narrow earnings bridges rather than a broad beta long.
WFH demand and severe supply/global-demand disruption coexist; useful for testing fail-closed mapping rather than assuming all hardware benefits.
